mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers central bank hawkishness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline YoY, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 3.5% in a late-cycle expansion signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 3.5% and economy is in late-cycle expansion (GDP growth > 2%, inflation > 2%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Positive non-farm payrolls growth supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive YoY, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of declining industrial production signal manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth above 2.5% in a late-cycle expansion signals robust consumer and business spending that drives corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.5% and economy is in late-cycle expansion (low unemployment, high consumer confidence), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate combined with CPI above 3.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
